parameters.name: localOnly
parameters.description: MPI data-parallel: expose this rank's tiles packed without gathering onto rank 0. Tiles are laid out in one vertical column, with image channel dimensions 32 by (localTileCount * 32), keeping each tile contiguous in memory. Map channel.tileInfo for matching dimensions and ANARI_INT32_VEC4 entries containing each tile's full-frame origin x/y and valid edge-clipped width/height. Pixels outside the valid image extent in an edge tile are zero for color, normals, motion, and IDs, and infinity for depth.
